Let \(t=\frac{x}{y}>0\). The condition becomes
\[
a t+\frac1t \ge 24-a \quad \text{for all } t>0.
\]
For \(a>0\), the minimum of \(a t+\frac1t\) is \(2\sqrt a\), attained at \(t=\frac1{\sqrt a}\). Thus we need
\[
2\sqrt a \ge 24-a.
\]
Let \(s=\sqrt a>0\). Then
\[
s^2+2s-24\ge 0 \implies (s+6)(s-4)\ge 0.
\]
Since \(s>0\), this gives \(s\ge 4\), so \(\sqrt a\ge 4\), hence
\[
a\ge 16.
\]
Therefore the minimum value is \(\boxed{16}\).
